## Wave 7 Summary

Wave 7 is the hygiene / provenance / convention-firewall wave for the S95-era capstone (`sessions/framework/phonic-exflation-equation.md`). It harvests convergence clusters **C4** (`f_NL` bound-vs-point mislabel — 3 reviewers: mack, hawking, dirac), **C5** (single-value-presented-for-multi-convention meta-cluster — ≈8 reviewers; here: Mellin pole-set + `R_K` normalization + canonical-pin absences), **C7** (PROVEN results omitted from the §7/§9 scorecard — ≈5 reviewers: cosmic-web `f·σ₈`, neutrino sector, van-den-dungen `c_s²=0`, berry `Ω=0`), and **C8** (surface-gravity/temperature KIND-tagging incomplete across §5.3 — ≈5 reviewers), plus dissonance **D3** (the §7.3 joint-evidence over-reach: the Wronskian licenses *algebraic* layer-independence, NOT *statistical* independence — sagan, mack, kaku).

Most W7 items are **fix-in-session METHODOLOGY-class** (rule-file / registry / `canonical_constants.py` / capstone edits whose PASS predicate is artifact-existence-with-substantive-content). Two are genuine **COMPUTE-class** (a number is produced against a pre-registered threshold): the `f_NL` central-value σ-distance reconcile (W7-1) and the D3 cross-layer covariance audit (W7-7a). One gate (W7-2 canonical-pins) is sourced entirely from prior-session verdicts and produces no new threshold-number — it is METHODOLOGY-class (`update_constant` PROVENANCE-entry-exists predicate). The MIXED gate (W7-7 joint-evidence) is sub-wave-decomposed into W7-7a (COMPUTE: covariance audit) + W7-7b (METHODOLOGY: §7.3 restriction edit) per `wave-classification.md §"NROY clause"`.

**Carry-forward source**: §V "Carry-Forward Computations" 4-field blocks of `mack`, `hawking`, `dirac`, `lizzi`, `baptista`, `sagan`, `kaku`, `cosmic-web`, `neutrino`, `van-den-dungen`, `berry`, `gen-physicist`, `sp`, `nazarewicz`, `tesla`, `kitaev`, `quantum-acoustics` synthesis files + `_consolidated-findings.md §II C4/C5/C7/C8` + `§III D3`.

Wave 7 is a **hygiene / provenance / firewall wave** and is structurally **independent of all other S96 waves' verdicts** — every input is either an already-landed prior-session value (S67/S70/S75/S77/S84/S88/S95 verdicts), a canonical-constants entry, a registry/capstone document, or a rule-file template. - **W7-7a** (D3 covariance audit) consumes the §7.1 † row values + the C10 tracking law + the S75 W2-E Wronskian certificate — all landed.
- No prereq is unmet at dispatch; no W7 gate needs mechanical closure per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md`. Should any input file be missing at runtime, the producing gate honestly closes per that rule (FAIL-with-remediation, not PASS).

**D3 workshop-candidate flag** (`Investigating-Workshops.md §Q1`): D3 (joint-evidence over-reach) is a genuine math/physics adjudication (algebraic-vs-statistical independence — two competing readings of what the Wronskian licenses) and is ALSO a `/rclab-investigate` workshop candidate per `_consolidated-findings.md §VI`. W7-7a/W7-7b pre-register its **compute leg + edit leg** here regardless; the adversarial-adjudication leg routes to the S96 workshop schedule. The compute leg's verdict feeds that workshop, it does not replace it.

## §W7-7. S96-HYG-JOINT-EVIDENCE-D3 (MIXED → sub-wave-decomposed)

> **Classification: MIXED-class → decomposed per `wave-classification.md §"NROY clause"`.** The joint-evidence restriction has a COMPUTE half (audit whether the OBSERVATIONAL residuals are statistically independent under the shared C10 borrowed-H(t) — kaku V.8 produces a covariance NUMBER) and a METHODOLOGY half (restrict the §7.3 joint-BF claim text to the zero-parameter structural spine — an Edit). A single gate cannot be both; sub-waves W7-7a (COMPUTE) + W7-7b (METHODOLOGY) get independent gate-IDs + verdict lines. D3 is ALSO a `/rclab-investigate` Q1 workshop candidate — pre-register both legs here; the adversarial-adjudication leg routes to the S96 workshop schedule. Source: kaku V.8 (`CROSS-LAYER-INDEP-AUDIT`) + mack CF-MACK-7 (prior-predictive-range reframe) + sagan §7.3 over-reach flag.

### §W7-7a. S96-HYG-JOINT-EVIDENCE-D3-COVARIANCE (COMPUTE half)

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S96-HYG-JOINT-EVIDENCE-D3-COVARIANCE"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"   # directional: does shared-H(t) INDUCE cross-layer correlation (sign of ∂residual/∂H products)?
classification: "PHONONIC"   # the residuals are on substrate spectral-moment layers (a₀/a₂/a₄ observables)
agent_type: "gen-physicist"   # cross-domain UQ audit spanning a₀ (CC/w₀), a₂ (σ₈), a₄ (m_H) layers
hypothesis: "The §7.3 joint-evidence claim multiplies observational improbabilities across a₀×a₂×a₄ layers, licensed by the Wronskian W∝R_K′³ (ALGEBRAIC layer-independence, S75 W2-E). But algebraic independence ≠ statistical independence: the C10-borrowed external H(t) is shared across all dagger rows (w₀, wₐ, σ₈, CC), so ∂(residual_i)/∂H may be non-zero and correlated across layers, breaking the multiplication. Compute the cross-layer covariance of the residuals under a shared δH/H perturbation."

method:
  description: "Per kaku V.8: compute ∂(residual_i)/∂H for each layer — w₀-residual on a₀ (via C10 ρ_vac∼M_Pl²H²), σ₈-residual on a₂ (growth channel), m_H-residual on a₄ (KK-threshold, H-independent). Form the cross-layer covariance matrix under a shared-H(t) perturbation δH/H. The off-diagonal a₀-a₂ term is the product ∂(w₀-resid)/∂H · ∂(σ₈-resid)/∂H (both H-dependent); the a₄ row is ~H-independent (m_H is a fiber-threshold mass, decoupled from H(t)). PASS if ∂(residual)/∂H is negligible OR uncorrelated across layers (algebraic ⇒ statistical independence here); INFO if correlation present but small; FAIL if shared-H(t) induces strong cross-layer correlation (the §7.3 product is overstated and must be re-derived with the correlation matrix). Pre-register: the BF must NOT multiply WITHIN-layer observables (Ω_DM and σ₈ both on a₂ → not multiplied)."
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s96_hyg_joint_evidence_d3_covariance.py"

operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: "max_offdiag |Corr(residual_i, residual_j)| over {(a₀,a₂),(a₀,a₄),(a₂,a₄)} under shared δH/H ; PASS if < 0.1 (negligible), INFO if 0.1–0.5, FAIL if > 0.5"

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "max off-diagonal |cross-layer residual correlation| < 0.1 under a shared-H(t) perturbation"
  direction: "<"

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "∂(residual)/∂H is computed from the closed-form C10 tracking law ρ_vac∼M_Pl²H² (a₀ layer) + the growth-rate H-dependence (a₂ layer) + the H-independence of the a₄ KK-threshold m_H; the covariance is the analytic product structure. Substitution chain below."

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous (correlation coefficients ∈ [−1,1]); the perturbation δH/H is a small continuous parameter"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "3 layers (a₀/a₂/a₄) × 3 cross-pairs covariance matrix; 1 shared perturbation δH/H"
  L_max: "N/A — observational-residual UQ, not a spectral truncation (uses pinned § 7.1 values)"
  scan_range: "δH/H ∈ [−0.05, +0.05] (a small shared-H perturbation; 11-point)"
  step_size: "0.01 in δH/H"
  tolerance: "correlation threshold 0.1 (PASS) / 0.5 (FAIL); residual derivatives to rel_tol 1e-6"
  scheme: "shared-H(t)-perturbation-covariance"
  convention: "cross-LAYER only (a₀×a₂×a₄); WITHIN-layer (Ω_DM,σ₈ both a₂) NOT multiplied — pre-registered"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (analytic ∂residual/∂H; no MC)"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 (3×3 covariance; scalar derivatives)"

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true   # contains a directional claim ("shared-H(t) INDUCES correlation" / "breaks the multiplication")
  content: |
    Claim: "If the C10 borrowed-H(t) induces correlated residual shifts across the a₀/a₂ layers, the §7.3 product of improbabilities OVER-states the joint evidence."
    Definition 1: residual_a0 := (w₀_obs − w₀_FW) — the a₀-layer dark-energy residual [w₀ borrowed via C10: ρ_vac ∼ M_Pl²H²]
    Definition 2: residual_a2 := (σ₈_obs − σ₈_FW) — the a₂-layer growth residual [σ₈ growth depends on the borrowed H(z)]
    Definition 3: residual_a4 := (m_H_obs − m_H_FW) — the a₄-layer Higgs-mass residual [m_H is a KK-threshold fiber mass, H-INDEPENDENT]
    Definition 4: joint-BF (§7.3) := Π_layers P(residual_i in posterior)/P(prior-predictive) , licensed by the Wronskian ALGEBRAIC independence W∝R_K′³ ≠ 0 off τ=0
    Substitute (shared-H perturbation): under δH, residual_a0 shifts by ∂(w₀_FW)/∂H · δH (C10) ; residual_a2 shifts by ∂(σ₈)/∂H · δH ; residual_a4 shifts by ~0 (H-independent)
    Substitute (covariance): Cov(residual_a0, residual_a2) = ∂(w₀)/∂H · ∂(σ₈)/∂H · Var(δH)   [non-zero IFF both layers are H-sensitive]
                           Cov(*, residual_a4) ≈ 0   [a₄ H-independent]
    Simplify:    Corr(a0,a2) = sign(∂w₀/∂H · ∂σ₈/∂H) × |…| ; the a0-a2 pair is the only candidate for induced correlation
    Canonical form: ALGEBRAIC independence (W≠0) does NOT imply Cov=0 ; the joint product is valid ONLY IF the OBSERVATIONAL residual covariance is also negligible
    Direction:   IF Corr(a0,a2) is large ⇒ the shared H(t) correlates the residuals ⇒ multiplying them OVER-states the joint improbability (treats correlated factors as independent)
                 IF Corr(a0,a2) ≈ 0 ⇒ algebraic independence carries to statistical independence HERE ⇒ the product is valid (to leading order)
    Conclusion:  the verdict is the measured max off-diagonal correlation; it decides whether §7.3's multiplication stands, needs a hedge (INFO), or must be re-derived with the correlation matrix (FAIL). [now justified — the DIRECTION (over-state vs valid) is read from the sign+magnitude of the off-diagonal covariance, NOT pre-judged]
```
